title: Command Hierarchy, Roles, Orders & Communication
objective: Implement read-only command hierarchy, role/delegation, order-lifecycle and communication projections over completed SCL-01/SCL-02 identities while preserving ODL owner evidence, Permission/visibility and Action/Combat/Event authority; SCL-04 retains mechanical resolution.

allowed_sources: A6 Action authority as frozen by SCL-01
tranche_context.expansion_rule: Context expansion is denied unless a named source is missing/contradictory, changed validation evidence identifies a concrete dependency, canonical branch/authority state drifts, or the owner explicitly requests expansion.

resolved_contract.relationship_rule: Command relationships are read-only SCL projections linking explicit SCL-02 profile ids and/or canonical subject references. They do not assign canonical organizational roles, permissions, action authority or ownership.
resolved_contract.delegation_rule: Delegated command scope must cite explicit visible ODL-04 role/delegation/authority-scope owner evidence. Missing or conflicting delegation remains unresolved and never becomes permission or action authority.
resolved_contract.order_rule: SCL-03 represents visible command intent and lifecycle evidence only. It may project that an order was issued/acknowledged/received but performs no issuance mutation, Action execution, Combat/Event resolution or outcome adjudication.
resolved_contract.communication_rule: Communication is a read-only projection over explicit channel, sender, recipient, range, delay and interruption evidence. Bands are descriptive only and create no travel-time, initiative, action-cost, morale, logistics or resolution effect.
resolved_contract.visibility_rule: Permission/visibility filtering occurs before hierarchy membership, role/delegation scope, order existence/state, communication existence/state, counts, summaries, search text, provenance, deterministic receipts or AI context. Hidden existence/cardinality remain undisclosed.
resolved_contract.unknown_conflict_rule: Missing, unknown, conflicting or incompatible visible evidence remains conservative and incomplete; no role, order state, communication state, delegation or authority is guessed or auto-reconciled.
resolved_contract.determinism_rule: Stable relationship-id, order-id, communication-id and canonical-reference ordering determines projection and receipt truth; presentation prose is excluded from canonical receipts.

authority_handoffs.SCL-04: mechanical/deterministic order resolution and outcome adjudication

resolved_contract.ai_rule: AI may advise only where separately governed. SCL-03 invokes no provider and grants no autonomous command, order issuance, adjudication, permission, owner mutation or completion authority.
resolved_contract.persistence: No durable SCL-03 ledger or migration. Migration 0022 remains unreserved.

acceptance_contract.red_rule: Acceptance/proof/profile/verifier land before production contract/panel and must fail at intended missing production imports after invariants/install pass on both self-hosted lanes.
acceptance_contract.green_rule: Exactly one SCL-03 current-family profile passes exact-head repository health, self-hosted Linux, self-hosted Windows and deterministic comparison with zero historical predecessor fanout.

preserved_boundaries: SCL-01 and SCL-02 remain completed_verified and frozen.
ODL-04 remains authoritative for organization role/delegation/communication owner evidence; SCL-03 does not mutate it.
Permission/visibility and ordinary Action/Combat/Event plus canonical constituent/owner-domain truth remain authoritative.
SCL-03 projects command intent/relationships only; SCL-04 retains mechanical resolution and outcome adjudication.
No owner mutation, AI autonomous command/adjudication, hidden-data reveal, duplicate ledger, durable persistence or migration 0022 is authorized.
SCL-04+, MAL-01+, provider activation, tester distribution, release and deployment remain unauthorized.
next_action: Land acceptance/proof/profile/verifier first, establish genuine matching cross-platform RED, then add the production contract/panel and carry exact-head GREEN through application merge, AIOC closeout and SCL-04 selection in this owner Continue.
